title: Turkish Kofte Lettuce Wraps
description: A refreshing and flavorful Turkish-inspired dish featuring kofte patties wrapped in crisp lettuce leaves.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, crushed cig, kofte spice mix, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape into patties.
Grill the kofte patties for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the lettuce leaves by grilling them for 30 seconds on each side.
Assemble the wraps by placing a kofte patty onto a toasted lettuce leaf, followed by a dollop of Turkish yogurt and a sprinkle of parsley.
Chill any leftovers in an airtight container for up to 24 hours.
